_about: Content check controls (#1061): made-course lessons that break the rules of one category (content_check::CATEGORIES), 'obvious' (plain wording, a listed term where the category has one) and 'subtle' (no listed term, softened or indirect), and 'fine' look-alikes that must pass. Harmful text is described in placeholder words, never written out. cargo test controls runs the term check over every one; scripts/content-check-controls.sh runs Jev and the stage 2 review and prints a scorecard. Notes: data/moderation/CONTROLS.md.
